$comment: P15 — the performance budget, asserted rather than admired.
HANDOFF records an honest gap: the P12 font work is structurally verified —
zero external origins is not a matter of measurement — but its effect on LCP
was never independently confirmed, because PageSpeed Insights rate-limited
every attempt from that network. This is the fix for that: the number gets
measured on every run instead of being asked for once and never again.
Three runs per URL because Lighthouse's own variance on a shared CI runner is
several points; a single run would fail the build on noise. The median is what
The categories are thresholds, not aspirations. Accessibility and best
practices are pinned at 1.0 because both are pass/fail checklists where a
miss is a real defect — and because axe already covers accessibility in the
E2E suite, so a Lighthouse a11y regression means something the E2E excluded.
